title: Redirect to another host (Location header)
description: The response redirects to a different host through its Location header. A redirect to another host is not a vulnerability by itself. It becomes one when an attacker chooses the target. This check reads one observed redirect and confirms the host changes.
remediation: Redirect only to relative paths or an allow-listed host (a relative path or an allow-listed host).
limitation: Single-response check: it cannot tell whether the target is attacker-controlled. Passive scope only; no redirect is followed. A protocol-relative target is also reported by DPK-DAST-050 (the owner-blocked protocol-relative rule) and a target that carries credentials is also reported by DPK-DAST-085; both pairs are recorded in docs/DAST_OVERLAP_LEDGER.json, and this rule answers the host-change question only.
